cohort: The study included 74 primiparous women who had undergone a vaginal delivery.
finding: The most significant factor influencing the avulsion of the levator ani muscle during natural vaginal delivery was newborn weight.
mod_finding: The study found that newborn weight was the most important factor for LAM avulsion during natural vaginal deliveries.
birth_weight: Babies with a mean weight of 3193 g in the no-avulsion group and 3470 g in the avulsion group were included.
